angle: A 16-year-old who keeps deleting other people's records: Moukoko's, the Premier League's, and now Jude Bellingham's

open_loop: Bristol, 13 November 2026: a 16-year-old comes off the bench for England U21s and Jude Bellingham's record is gone. It is not the first record he has taken.

beats.fact: Max Dowman became the youngest player ever to represent England under-21s, coming on in a 1-0 defeat against Portugal in Bristol (Ashton Gate, 13 November). He beat the record set by Jude Bellingham, who played Kosovo in 2020.

numbers.bellingham_record_age: 17 years, two months and six days

beats.fact: Dowman signed for Arsenal on 18 May 2015. In August 2025 he became the second-youngest player in Premier League history when he featured against Leeds United.

On 4 November 2025 he came off the bench in the 72nd minute of Arsenal's 3-0 win at Slavia Prague and became the youngest player ever to feature in the Champions League, the first 15-year-old since the 1992 rebrand. He broke Youssoufa Moukoko's record (Borussia Dortmund v Zenit, December 2020). The week before, he had become the youngest player to start a game for Arsenal's men's first team, in the League Cup win over Brighton.

His most iconic moment: off the bench against Everton he set up the opener for Viktor Gyokeres, then scored a stunning solo goal that was voted Arsenal's 2025/26 Goal of the Season. Separately, Arsenal's profile lists him as the youngest goalscorer in Premier League history (the profile does not say which goal set that record).
